# What is Kailash {#what-is-kailash}

Kailash OS is a **NixOS-based Linux distribution** assembled for AI
security work. It packages, in one declaratively built environment, the
offensive, defensive and platform tooling needed to test and operate
AI/ML systems — the same reproducibility discipline nix gives any other
system, applied to a security research catalogue.

## Why it exists

Security work on AI systems needs tooling that is:

- **Reproducible** — an experimental result only counts if it can be
  re-run against the same tool versions; every package is pinned to an
  exact source revision with a content hash.
- **Declared, not implied** — the tool catalogue is a single manifest
  that drives packaging, the desktop menu, the CLI and this guide;
  nothing is installed ad hoc.
- **Safety-aware by construction** — tools that talk to live targets
  or run experimental code are classified and gated, not silently
  enabled.

## Who it is for

Practitioners and researchers doing AI security assessment: red-team
work against LLM systems, defensive evaluation of deployed models,
and platform engineering for AI/ML infrastructure under observation.
